brief: A mobile-first public library service for rural towns. Residents search the shared book catalogue, reserve books for branch pickup, join reading circles, and find local author events. Volunteers coordinate opening hours and hold queues across three branches. Make browsing work on weak connections, provide large text and screen-reader friendly controls, and keep member reading history private. No book sales, purchases, payments, bank accounts, bill pay, or financial dashboards.
